answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybil swarms. A new agent streaks in like a comet and posts a 60-credit bond shrinking 5% per epoch. A faker minting 1,000 identities pays 60,000 up front plus 3,000 per epoch to keep them alive, while the decay ripple exposes dormant shells. The canyon between one honest bond and a thousand decaying ones makes forgery unprofitable: the honest agent pays 60 once and tops up 3 per epoch, keeping its reward whole.
